## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and before/after behavior. Link the issue and its
criteria; merging this PR alone does not close unqualified device/owner gates.

## Validation

Record exact source revision, commands, platform and outcomes. Distinguish
passed, failed, skipped, unavailable and unrun checks. Include relevant local act
job/event/matrix and direct fallback evidence; do not reuse older receipts for
new source. Keep real keys, private profiles and unreviewed logs out of the PR.

## Compatibility and remaining gates

Explain v0/offline/configuration/update/rollback/secret-filtering effects and
remaining device, hosted CI, review, rights, owner or publication requirements.
Link updated continuity/release evidence where applicable. Release/deployment
approval concerns prepared exact artifacts and destinations, not this template.
